messages:
Nina CSM: Heads-up 10 BlueHarbor is asking for a short-term 3mo bridge renewal while they finish budget for full year. Procurement will only sign with PO + vendor code. They also requested a DPA copy and SOC2 attestation before countersign.
Sam Procurement (BlueHarbor): Confirmed. We can issue PO if vendor code and DPA are attached. Can Redwood accept PO as a PDF attachment on the DocuSign envelope? Also prefers Net45 payment terms.
Tom Sales: We can do a 3mo bridge but prefer Net30 normally. Net45 ok if Finance approves. Suggest offering a 5% one-time start-up credit to keep timing smooth. Thoughts? :+1:
Mark Finance: Net45 increases DSO; need approval from finance lead for Net45 on renewals. 5% one-time credit acceptable as long as it's flagged non-recurring in SF. Billing entity must match PO exactly.
Ava Legal: DPA request noted. We can provide standard Redwood DPA and a short amendment for the 3mo term. Will add clause: "3-month bridge term; one-time onboarding credit of 5% applied to first invoice; credit non-recurring." Also want to add a revocation clause if SOC2 evidence not provided within 14 days.
Nina CSM: I'll upload DPA and SOC2 attestation to DocSend. docsend-bot: "BlueHarbor renewal packet uploaded: https://docsend.example/s/bh-bridge-2191234567"
Sam Procurement (BlueHarbor): Great. Vendor code is BH-2024. We'll prepare PO once we see DocSend and DocuSign. We can attach PDF PO to the envelope.
Tom Sales: Quick note: Sales leadership prefers we avoid extending Net45 broadly. I'll loop in Raj for approval; please treat this as an exception if approved.
Mark Finance: Raj ok'd Net45 for this one-time bridge given procurement constraints. Please ensure invoice terms reflect Net45 and reference PO# on the invoice.
Ava Legal: Uploaded amendment draft to DocuSign. DocuSign envelope ID: dsign-2191234567. Routing: BlueHarbor signers -> Redwood Legal (Ava) -> Redwood Finance (Mark). Do not edit PDF post-upload.
Nina CSM: BlueHarbor said they can sign same day after PO attached. Sam please attach PO PDF to envelope and confirm numer as PO-9432.
Sam Procurement (BlueHarbor): PO attached to DocuSign, number PO-9432. Attached vendor code BH-2024 on PO.
Mark Finance: PO received in SF and marked "PO received". Generating invoice Net45 with 5% credit applied to first invoice.
Tom Sales: I'll flag this as one-off concession in the contract notes to avoid precedent.
Ava Legal: Closing loop: DPA and SOC2 found acceptable; amendment includes revocation if SOC2 not provided in 14d. Routing complete 19. Everyone please confirm once funds/PO processed.
Nina CSM: Thanks team. BlueHarbor confirmed signature sent back. :tada:
